title: Shelf life and time-resolved thermal, chemical, and thermodynamic characterization of four hydrophobic deep eutectic solvents
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23754-23769
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01239F, Paper

Adewale Ajose, Gary A. Leeke, Pritha Sen, Preeti Singh, Pratik Kokane, Syed Altaf, Matthew J. Keith
Comprehensive 20-week characterization reveals that thymol and TOAB hydrophobic deep eutectic solvents remain thermally and thermodynamically stable, supporting their deployment in extraction and polymer-processing applications.
